program.name: Iron PPL
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Classic push, pull and legs days with heavier dumbbell and kettlebell work in straight sets.
program.about: Push, pull and legs days built around heavier dumbbell and kettlebell work. Each session is longer straight sets with fewer, bigger exercises and abs to finish. Level II moves you one weight up, and Level III slows every lowering to three seconds. For building strength when you have 40 minutes.
